mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by more than 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY decline > 2% and UNRATE > 7%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and real personal consumption (RSAFS) is below its 12-month moving average, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and RSAFS < 12mo MA
failure_condition: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and RSAFS < 12mo MA, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a high-inflation environment that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY rise > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption (RSAFS) rises by more than 5% year-over-year and housing starts (HOUST) are above their 12-month moving average, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY rise > 5% and HOUST > 12mo MA
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY rise > 5% and HOUST > 12mo MA, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
